response.overview: # English Translation  Two years have passed since Sufiya (Dira) left Adani (Sharifah Aryana) and her younger siblings because she could not endure the bad behavior of her hot-tempered and abusive husband. Due to frequent abuse, Adani and her siblings were determined to run away from their father to reunite with their beloved mother. Adani, a dedicated older sister who takes care of her four younger siblings Amir, Adam, Ahmad and Azra. She also constantly ensures that they are protected from becoming victims of their father's abuse. This Ramadan, Adani is determined to take her siblings away to find their mother, Sufiya, who had left them. Sufiya had promised Adani that she would give her children a perfect life. She also promised to return to the village to get her children back after successfully having a stable job and her own place to live.
